title: No Kelp And Seagrass
body:
# 🌊 Clear Oceans, Higher FPS!
Are you tired of your frame rate dropping every time you look at an ocean biome? Do those pesky Kelp and Seagrass plants clutter your view and drain your performance?

The "No Kelp And Seagrass" Resource Pack is designed specifically for players who want a cleaner underwater view and, more importantly, a smoother gameplay experience.

### ✨ Key Features:
- 🚀 Performance Boost: By removing the rendering overhead of Kelp and Seagrass, you can achieve more stable FPS in ocean biomes.
- 🔍 Crystal Clear Visibility: No more visual clutter! See through the water effortlessly, making underwater exploration and base building much easier.
- 🍃 Minimalist Aesthetic: Perfect for players who prefer a clean, unobstructed underwater look.

### Ideal for:
- Low-end PC users.
- Underwater base builders.
- PvP players needing clear visibility.
